title: 第八章 夜探藏珠
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
然而画面中出现的，却是谢家家主谢临坤与一名女修私会的场景，更有诸多不堪入目的画面和让人脸红的声音传出……

    谢清猗原本唇角轻扬，瞬息表情僵在鲛纱之后，面颊微微泛红，若可以，她觉得自己的脑门上大概挂着三道黑线。

    她不由得轻“啧”了声，随手将那枚影留珠丢回盒中。

    嘴角微抽，这家主夫人是有什么奇怪嗜好，还是留作抓把柄的铁证？再说家主，原身的大伯，除了荣怀音还有不少妾室和炉鼎。

    她不懂，荣怀音明知他有那么多女人，何必还专门存下这个？难道影留珠里这女修，身份有什么不同？

    谢清猗觉得自己莫名吃了个瓜。

    这时，石壁上的灵烛火光微微一跳，晃了一瞬。

    她立刻抬头朝那边扫了一眼，又将手探向旁边同样的木盒，盒子一打开，映入眼帘的是另一枚影留珠，沉下去的心在这一刻又快速跳动起来，但愿是她要找的那一枚，千万别再是什么辣眼睛的画面。

    如法炮制，她迅速以灵力催动影留珠，这次的画面并未先出现，反而隐隐约约，从里面传出一对男女说话的声音。她感到心口一紧，那声音仿佛触动了原身沉睡的记忆……是原身父母的声音。

    “好大胆子的小贼，竟敢来我谢家偷东西。”一道女声从身后不远处冷冷传来。

    谢清猗瞬间切断画面，感到身后一道裹挟杀意的凌厉攻击已朝她袭来，她身形微晃，一头如缎青丝随着动作拂起，侧身转头，堪堪避过那一击，抬眸看去，来人正是荣怀音。

    心中先是一凛，随即回过神来，对方并未认出自己。心念一转，两人之前从未交过手，荣怀音对原身的招式术法并不熟悉，只要她不用本命剑，不催动灵根，身份便不会暴露。

    电光石火间，她探手抓过身旁架子上一柄长剑，足尖一点，身姿轻盈如燕雀，手中长剑如破开幽暗，凌厉地剑气朝对方疾刺而去。

    就在谢清猗身形一闪，剑锋即将刺到荣怀音时，对方掌心忽地凝出一道如水的链索，水环节节相扣，在幽暗烛火下泛着冷光，反手便朝她袭来。

    看见对方的动作，她眸光一闪，原身对荣怀音不够了解，只喜对方修为和灵根，她现在不能催动灵根，毕竟原身冰灵根太过特殊，一出手便露底，而此刻手中长剑，一寸短一寸险。

    而对方水灵根柔韧灵活，链索在水中般的轨迹飘忽难测，好在原身确是天资卓绝的剑修，剑意凛然，早已远超同阶。

    谢清猗顺着身体的记忆，在锁链疾射而来的瞬息朝身侧一掠，手中长剑与链索相击，交击之声在石室中炸响，她借力旋身，灵烛晃动，深紫裙摆拂动映在墙壁上的影子骤然绽开，人已落在荣怀音身后。

    才交手两招，她便看出来了，这位家主夫人修为虽不低，可实战经验却很少，同等修为的情况下，不要说一般修士，更不可敌顶级仙府的核心弟子。

    谢清猗心口微松，对方是养尊处优太久，还是水灵根本就偏柔，于剑修而言太过绵软？不过，好在她不是乐修，否则在她不能用灵根的情况下，只会更难缠。
content_en:
However, what appeared on the screen was the scene of Xie Linkun, the head of the Xie family, having a private meeting with a female nun. There were also many unsightly scenes and blushing sounds...

    Xie Qingyi's lips were slightly raised, but her expression froze behind the veil for a moment, and her cheeks were slightly red. If she could, she felt that there were probably three black lines hanging on her forehead.

    She couldn't help but let out a soft "tsk" sound and threw the shadow bead back into the box.

    The corners of her mouth twitched slightly. Did the housewife have any strange hobbies, or was she keeping this as ironclad evidence? Besides Rong Huaiyin, the head of the family, his original uncle, also had many concubines and furnaces.

    She didn't understand. Rong Huaiyin knew that he had so many women, so why did he save this one? Is there any difference in the identity of the female cultivator in Yingliuzhu?

    Xie Qingyi felt that he had eaten something for no reason.

    At this time, the light of the spiritual candle on the stone wall jumped slightly and flickered for a moment.

    She immediately raised her head and glanced over there, then reached out to the same wooden box next to her. When the box was opened, another shadow bead came into view. Her sinking heart started to beat rapidly again at this moment. She hoped it was the one she was looking for, and there would be no more eye-catching scenes.

    Following the same pattern, she quickly used her spiritual power to activate the Yingliuzhu. This time, the scene did not appear first. Instead, the voices of a man and a woman talking were faintly heard from inside. She felt her heart tighten. The voice seemed to touch the sleeping memory of the original body... It was the voice of the original body's parents.

    "What a bold little thief, how dare you come to my Xie house to steal something." A female voice came coldly from not far behind.

    Xie Qingyi cut off the screen instantly and felt a fierce attack with murderous intent coming towards her from behind. She swayed slightly, her hair as silk as silk brushed with the movement, turned her head sideways, barely avoiding the attack, and looked up to see that the person coming was none other than Rong Huaiyin.

    There was a shock in my heart at first, and then I came back to my senses. The other party did not recognize me. After a thought, the two of them had never fought before, and Rong Huaiyin was not familiar with her original moves and techniques. As long as she didn't use her natal sword or activate her spiritual roots, her identity would not be exposed.

    In the flash of lightning, she reached out and grabbed a long sword on the shelf beside her. Pointing her toes, her body was as light as a sparrow. The long sword in her hand seemed to break through the darkness, and she stabbed towards the opponent with sharp sword energy.

    Just when Xie Qingyi's body flashed and the sword edge was about to stab Rong Huaiyin, a water-like chain suddenly formed in the opponent's palm. The water links were interlocked, glowing coldly under the dim candlelight, and he attacked her with his backhand.

    Seeing the other party's actions, her eyes flashed. The original person didn't know Rong Huaiyin well enough, and she only liked the other person's cultivation and spiritual roots. She couldn't activate the spiritual roots now. After all, the original ice spirit root was too special and would be exposed as soon as she made a move. The sword in her hand was now one inch short and one inch dangerous.

    The other party's water spirit root is flexible and flexible, and the trajectory of the chain rope is erratic and unpredictable. Fortunately, the original person is indeed an extremely talented swordsman, and his sword intention is awe-inspiring, far beyond the same level.

    Xie Qingyi followed her body's memory and swooped to the side at the moment when the chain was coming. The long sword in her hand collided with the chain. The sound of the collision exploded in the stone room. She used her strength to spin around, the candle swayed, the dark purple skirt fluttered and the shadow reflected on the wall suddenly bloomed, and the person had fallen behind Rong Huaiyin.

    After only two moves, she could see that although the master's wife was not low in cultivation, she had very little actual combat experience. With the same cultivation level, not to mention ordinary monks, let alone the core disciples of the top immortal mansions, she could not defeat them.

    Xie Qingyi felt slightly relieved. Did the other party have been pampered for too long, or was Shuiling simply too soft for a sword cultivator? However, it is a good thing that she is not Lexiu, otherwise it will only be more difficult for her if she cannot use her spiritual roots.
title_en: Chapter 8 Exploring Hidden Beads at Night
